{#- LS Foods — Sales Invoice. Shows, per line, the case price, the unit price and the case weight, and a Total Weight (lb) at the foot beside the money totals. Items are stocked and sold in Cases, so there are no UOM conversions anywhere: Qty is cases, Rate is the price of a case, and custom_case_weight is simply the pounds in one case — typed on the line, so a heavy or light shipment prints its real weight. doc.total_net_weight is print_hide = 1 on the standard doctype and would never reach a PDF unless printed explicitly. Sales Invoice has NO document-level Weight UOM field (nor does Delivery Note), which is why "lb" is written into the label rather than read from a field. Every item carries Weight UOM = Lb, so the total is already in pounds. Beef / hog shares (share_billing.invoice_view) print first, laid out like the client's item build sheet: ( lbs.) Quarter Beef Deposit 4 x -600.00 -2,400.00 , hanging weight 370 lb x 6.50 2,405.00 Processing Fee 370 lb x 0.90 333.00 Balance due for this share 338.00 The deposit printed there is the share's Sales Order line (the fixed deposit); the money actually received is the invoice's advance, shown in the totals. An invoice with no shares prints exactly as before. -#} {%- set view = invoice_view(doc) %}
